cite.quote: Batteries died after about a year, not seven.
We replace batteries every 14 months across 300 doors. That is a job.

tests.hypothesis: Buyers choose the product that does best on battery.
tests.method: Run five buyer interviews and one side-by-side trial on battery, the reviews' own words as prompts.
tests.metric: buyers who name it among their top two reasons to choose
tests.why: 7 of 40 reviews in this sample raise it.
